name: Mining Area of the Great Copper Mountain in Falun
description: In the Dalarna region of central Sweden, the Great Pit at Falun is a vast hole left by centuries of copper mining. The mine ran from the 10th century until 1992 and once supplied as much as two-thirds of Europe's copper, helping to pay for Sweden's 17th-century wars. Today you can tour the mine as a museum and wander the planned town and old mining settlements around it.
